phase: Core tour-search product remains 9.0 across all eleven core areas. Standalone anytoour.ru root stabilization is temporarily the highest priority because shell/link/consent and authenticated lead-handoff regressions were confirmed during migration. SEO/site foundation remains 8.8 and indexing/publication remains deferred.

current_task.title: Stabilize standalone anytoour.ru root without regressing legacy V2
current_task.objective: Make the standalone root production-safe across public shell, authenticated lead handoff, consent/legal links and live search while preserving the legacy V2 route and all external contracts.
current_task.progress: PR #188 fixed standalone runtime/site-shell paths and dead full-site root-relative navigation. PR #189 fixed the standalone privacy consent destination while preserving legacy behavior. Lead investigation moved the HMAC-authenticated receiver to an in-process adapter handoff; PR #192 fixes the remaining deployment mismatch by installing receiver, adapter and lead helpers together on the legacy V2 runtime. Previous deploy 33218815099 proved public root healthy but failed only the lead validation probe. Current standalone deployment for PR #192 is queued behind the preceding serialized deploy and must be verified before declaring production green.
current_task.next_action: Verify the current-main Deploy anytoour.ru run after PR #192. Require public-root success, non-writing lead probe HTTP 422 Validation failed, then live Tourvisor search smoke. If green, perform root-specific responsive/full-flow audit; if red, inspect exact lead response/log and fix before unrelated roadmap work.

queue.title: SEO-ready brand shell and site foundation

recent_material_fixes.result: Standalone deploy now installs compatible receiver, adapter, pricing helper and idempotency helper together before the HMAC bridge is verified.
anytoour.ru consent links reach the existing privacy page; legacy anytour.online keeps its relative privacy path.
Standalone V2 assets resolve from runtime config and full-site destinations not deployed on the new root no longer point at dead anytoour.ru paths.
Legacy V2 again emits the Bitrix sessid required by the browser lead path.
Trip duration stays in the primary mobile search flow and night presets no longer require horizontal scrolling.
V2 no longer renders a second full footer; social/app destinations remain in a compact community pre-footer before the canonical footer.
Invalid child ages stay invalid and block search instead of being silently coerced or dropped.
Unsupported child counts and child-count/age-control mismatches block search instead of sending a different tourist composition.

deferred.reason: Explicitly disabled until owner launches traffic.
Root deployment does not itself authorize indexing; requires deliberate indexing/publication contract and real curated content.
Should be tied to reviewed factual pages rather than fabricated framework content.
Add only after real indexable public page types and visible content exist.

deferred.scope: PX7 price watch / proactive return intent

continuation_policy.priority: production_broken > lead_loss > incorrect_data > poor_ux > responsive_visual > weakest_sub9_score > brand_product_roadmap > cosmetic_refactor
continuation_policy.on_score_below_9: prioritize_weakest_material_area unless its remaining material work is explicitly product-blocked, then continue independent audits
